activities_window_check.name: activities_window_check
activities_window_check.value: "activities"."check_in_opens_at" is null or "activities"."check_in_closes_at" is null or "activities"."check_in_closes_at" > "activities"."check_in_opens_at"

certificates_subject_check.name: certificates_subject_check
certificates_subject_check.value: "certificates"."club_id" is not null or "certificates"."activity_id" is not null or "certificates"."event_id" is not null

submissions_kind_check.name: submissions_kind_check
submissions_kind_check.value: ("submissions"."kind" = 'file' and "submissions"."file_key" is not null) or ("submissions"."kind" = 'link' and "submissions"."url" is not null)
